svg.title: Ashford Vale - master site plan
svg.text: seat of the Baron on Castle Mount
fallow this year - sheep graze it
Where the old ford became a kingdom's heart
Surveyed for The Steward - a living world of 2 km x 2 km, ready to build in 3D
• Thin lines join ground of equal height (5 m)
• Every 1 px of the heightmap = 1 metre
Town gates (N, W, E & River Gate)
Long before the castle, travellers waded the River Ash at a shallow ford (23), and a village
grew beside it. The Nine Maidens (22) were already old on the hill above. When raiders came
over The Greycrown Hills, the first Baron raised a tower on Castle Mount, where the hills
curl round in a horseshoe and every road can be watched. The tower grew into Ashford Castle;
the village became the walled market town of Ashford; the monks of St. Hilda's Abbey brought
Today four watch-fires guard the ridges, mills turn on wind and water, and three great
fields feed the vale in rotation: one wheat, one barley and beans, one resting under the
You are The Steward - the Baron's hand in the vale. Every house on these sheets has a family
and every road a reason. Build it, walk it, and write its next chapter yourself.
